speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. You are a 47-year-old male with a new rash and recent cough, now seeing a provider for arthritis management. Is the rash itchy, painful, or does it look like hives or patches? Has the cough been productive, and do you have any joint pain or swelling?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mucocutaneous Lichen Planus or Drug Eruption (given sudden onset, mucositis, and arthritis history, though malignancy like Kaposi sarcoma or lymphoma must be ruled out due to age and systemic symptoms).

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP), Chest_X-Ray, Liver_Function_Tests, and HLA-B51 genetic testing.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology photos of the rash on the upper back and oral mucosa.
